rules.expected: submission explicitly reports neutral charge, sextet multiplicity, minimum verification or bounded failure, and diagnostics
site_predictions retain explicit nucleus, site and atom_identity for each completed requested environment; bounded failure may report a documented partial set

for complete status, predictions and separate fit metrics support the observed pattern; for bounded_failure, completed partial results and explicit unavailable metrics with diagnostics are assessed without fabricated values

for complete status, Fe-N and Fe-Cl distances are reported with units and compared to the stated experimental boundary; bounded_failure must identify unavailable geometry and why it could not be resolved
supports or appropriately bounds Fe(III)Cl@TCPP within explicit cluster-model limitations
